notes: New in 1.0.5: fixes web pages inside clones failing with net::ERR_CACHE_MISS - most visibly the Meta Account page (accountscenter.meta.com), which never loaded inside a clone while the real Muse app loaded it fine. Root cause: the engine asked the system about permissions using the clone's virtual identity, which the system does not know, so the INTERNET permission read as DENIED and the WebView blocked all network loads. Permission queries are now answered with the host identity (fix ported from the ZiTanIOI BlackBox fork, which documents this exact error). Includes 1.0.4 (toast when clones auto-update; every updater check logged) and 1.0.3 (clones follow Play Store Muse updates in place). Installs in place - clones and sign-ins are preserved.
